bizKimiz.metaDescription: NOVVES brings air movement together with engineering. Industrial ventilation, smoke extraction, jet fans and project-based engineering solutions.
bizKimiz.heroDesc: NOVVES transforms air movement from a mere flow into sustainable systems optimized through high engineering discipline.
bizKimiz.identitySubtitle: NOVVES brings air movement together with engineering.
identityParagraphs: NOVVES ELECTRIC MOTOR INC. is a manufacturing and engineering company operating in industrial ventilation systems, comfort ventilation solutions, smoke and heat extraction fans, jet fan systems, axial fans, and project-based custom engineering applications.

Founded on more than 20 years of industry experience by our founders Zeki Kadir Özüntürk and Erdal Özüntürk, NOVVES delivers solutions across a broad range of services from manufacturing to project engineering, engineering analyses to commissioning, technical documentation to after-sales support.

With the domestically produced fan systems we develop at our production facility in Yalova, we export to more than 30 countries from Turkey. Each of our products is designed and tested in line with goals of safety, performance, energy efficiency and compliance with international standards, and evaluated according to project requirements.

For NOVVES, ventilation is not merely air movement. It is a critical system solution where human safety, fire safety, indoor air quality, comfort, engineering accuracy and sustainable performance come together.
approachParagraphs: NOVVES is not merely a manufacturer that sells the fan systems it develops. It is an engineering-based end-to-end solution partner that analyzes every project within its own conditions and brings the right product together with the right application.

In enclosed parking ventilation systems, smoke control systems, industrial facility ventilation, commercial building ventilation and custom project applications, we carry out product selection, CFD analysis, technical calculation, project support, testing, field commissioning and after-sales technical service processes with a holistic approach.
Our goal is not merely to supply fans on every project; it is to develop safe, efficient, sustainable and long-lasting ventilation solutions.

services.title: Smoke and Heat Extraction System Design

bizKimiz.activityLead: Your strong solution partner in industrial ventilation, smoke extraction and air conditioning systems.
activityParagraphs: NOVVES develops innovative solutions in comfort ventilation, smoke and heat extraction systems, industrial fan solutions, air handling units, chiller systems and project-based HVAC engineering.

Offering engineering-focused products for different building types and project requirements, the NOVVES product range covers axial fans, jet fan systems, smoke extraction fans, roof fans, wall-mounted fans, box fans, industrial fans, electric motors, air handling units, chiller groups and automation-supported ventilation solutions.

For NOVVES, every project is not merely product supply; it means correct engineering analysis, appropriate product selection, energy efficiency, safe operation, long-lasting performance and sustainable system design.

activityFields.title: Comfort Ventilation
activityFields.desc: Ventilation solutions for healthy, efficient and livable indoor environments.
paragraphs: A large part of modern life is spent indoors. Therefore indoor air quality, fresh air circulation, energy efficiency and user comfort are critical for every building.

With its comfort ventilation systems, NOVVES offers tailored solutions for commercial buildings, industrial facilities, shopping centers, hotels, public buildings, production areas and custom projects.

Thanks to our wide product range, strong manufacturing infrastructure and technical engineering support, we aim for the right fan selection, appropriate airflow, efficient operation and long-lasting performance on every project.

activityFields.title: Air Handling Units and HVAC Solutions
activityFields.desc: Engineering-focused solutions for fresh air, filtration, heat recovery and air conditioning requirements.
paragraphs: NOVVES develops air handling unit and HVAC solutions for commercial buildings, industrial facilities, production areas, hotels, shopping centers, hospitals, public buildings and custom projects.

Air handling units are among the most critical HVAC equipment in modern buildings for fresh air supply, air filtration, heating, cooling, humidity control, heat recovery and improved indoor air quality.

Based on project requirements, NOVVES evaluates criteria such as correct capacity selection, airflow calculation, fan-motor matching, energy efficiency, filtration level, automation integration and maintenance access together to deliver long-lasting and efficient system solutions.
items: Filtration and indoor air quality solutions

activityFields.title: Chiller and Cooling Systems
activityFields.desc: Efficient cooling solutions for industrial and commercial buildings.
paragraphs: NOVVES provides chiller systems and cooling solutions for central air conditioning, process cooling and commercial cooling requirements.

Chiller systems play a critical role in air conditioning and process cooling in hotels, shopping centers, hospitals, production facilities, data centers, public buildings and large-scale commercial structures.

Based on project requirements, NOVVES supports selection of the right cooling solution by considering cooling capacity, energy efficiency, operating conditions, equipment integration, ease of maintenance, automation compatibility and long-term operating costs.

activityFields.title: Smoke and Heat Exhaust Systems
activityFields.desc: Controlled smoke exhaust solutions for fire safety.
paragraphs: During a fire, one of the greatest risks is not only the flame but the spread of smoke. Smoke reduces visibility, makes evacuation difficult and creates a critical life safety risk.

NOVVES develops smoke and heat exhaust fans, jet fan systems and smoke control solutions for enclosed parking garages, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, tunnels, technical spaces and large enclosed areas.

Through CFD analysis, smoke control engineering, fan selection, automation scenarios, on-site commissioning and technical support, we help ensure projects are evaluated safely, efficiently and in compliance with standards.
items: Fan layout based on fire scenarios

ceoMesaji.metaDescription: Message from Novves Chairman and CEO Zeki Kadir Özüntürk.
ceoMesaji.heroDesc: Zeki Kadir Özüntürk's vision and NOVVES's story built on engineering excellence.
paragraphsBeforeQuote: Welcome to the NOVVES family. We are pleased to see you here.

As NOVVES ELECTRIC MOTOR INC., we develop reliable, innovative and high-performance products in industrial ventilation systems, comfort ventilation, smoke extraction fans, jet fan systems, axial fans, electric motors and project-based custom engineering solutions.

For us, ventilation is not merely air movement. Human safety, fire safety, energy efficiency, indoor air quality, comfort and engineering accuracy must be addressed as an integrated critical system. With this approach, we deliver tailored ventilation and smoke extraction solutions for enclosed car parks, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, infrastructure projects, production areas and special applications.

Thanks to our R&D-focused approach, strong production infrastructure and experienced technical team, we meticulously carry out project analysis, fan selection, CFD simulation, technical documentation, testing, quality control, commissioning and after-sales support. Our goal is not only to manufacture fans, but to develop reliable, sustainable, energy-efficient and long-lasting system solutions.

NOVVES, which we founded together with co-founder Erdal Özüntürk, today adds engineering value to many projects in Turkey and global markets with a portfolio of more than 1,200 products. Our work across Turkey and in more than 30 countries is the strongest indicator of our commitment to quality, reliability and continuous improvement.
ceoMesaji.pullQuote: For us, quality is not a coincidence but the natural result of a systematic process.
paragraphsAfterQuote: We will continue to invest in technology, occupational safety, the environment and sustainable manufacturing. With digital engineering tools, energy-efficiency-focused fan and motor solutions, our expanding export network and strong R&D culture, we are determined to make NOVVES a stronger global industrial ventilation brand.

On our website you can explore smoke extraction fans, jet fan systems, axial fans, industrial fans, electric motors and project-based ventilation solutions; and send technical support and solution requests for your projects to our team.
As NOVVES, we are pleased to add trust, performance and engineering value to your projects.
ceoMesaji.closingThanks: Thank you for your interest and trust.

sections.title: Environment and Sustainability
items: We use natural resources efficiently and effectively.
We minimize waste and dispose of it without harming the environment.
We prevent all kinds of pollution at the source and carry out environmentally friendly activities.
We continuously improve recycling, reuse and other waste management practices.
We aim to be a pioneer in energy efficiency and sustainable energy use.
We authorize our employees to stop work that could harm the environment when necessary.

sections.title: Occupational Health and Safety
items: We evaluate environmental and occupational risks to establish systems for preventing workplace accidents.
We use safe, sustainable and modern technologies in all our equipment.
We implement training and preventive measures to prevent occupational diseases.
We adopt a proactive approach to anticipate risks and take preventive measures.
We continuously review our occupational health and safety performance and update our goals.

sections.title: Employee Participation and Development
items: We organize regular training to increase the knowledge and competence of all our employees.
We integrate employee representatives into decision-making processes and encourage active participation.
We increase organizational commitment by removing barriers to participation.

sections.title: Performance and Stakeholder Focus
items: We analyze the expectations of relevant parties and plan appropriate actions.
We aim to exceed customer satisfaction beyond expectations.
We continuously improve the effectiveness of the Integrated Management System and measure our system performance.
Together with our suppliers and employees, we lead exemplary practices for the industry.

politikamiz.closingQuote: NOVVES Elektrik Motor A.Ş. sees sustainability, quality and occupational safety as a holistic system; it continues to create value by reflecting its integrated management approach in all its processes.
